findings.description: /agent-comms/send route (controlServer.ts:277-293) + sendAgentMessage() (controlClient.ts:126-141) carry no channel field and only request|reply|notify kinds; a spawn-request cannot traverse them.
findings.resolution: US-003 widens the route schema + helper to carry channel/spawn kinds; controlClient.ts added to Files to Modify.

findings.description: Approved-spawn execution path underspecified: body schema, SpawnSessionFromSessionRpcOptions mapping, result envelope, idempotency.
findings.resolution: US-005 specifies spawn-request body schema, mapping, default-deny + approvedForSpawn allowlist, pending-spawns.json, envelope.id/correlationId dedupe, spawn-result reply; new idempotency AC + risk.

findings.description: Ingest closure (run.ts:219-241) built before spawnSessionFromSessionHandler (run.ts:939-956); cannot call it directly.
findings.resolution: US-005 injects the handler via a deferred/promise indirection mirroring run.ts:849-859.

findings.description: 'Preserve §5.4 byte-for-byte' conflicted with pre-pinned-peer v1 (§5.4 describes first-contact auto-exchange).
findings.resolution: Re-scoped preservation to the §5.4 backend-observable verification chain + §5.3 public contract; noted first-contact auto-exchange is unimplemented skeleton and pre-pinned v1 is consistent with §8.1.

findings.description: US-004 readiness probe risks flaky external Dev-Tunnels dependency on daemon boot; host starts before listener binds.
findings.resolution: US-004 readiness made log-only/non-fatal, targets local listener after tunnel.start(); CI proof from startHost/route-registration tests.

findings.description: pinPeerKeys() (peerAuth.ts:102-119) reconstructs the record and would drop operator-authored tunnelName/tunnelId/approvedForSpawn on repin.
findings.resolution: US-002 must merge (not overwrite) operator fields on repin.

findings.description: Pending-approval queue over-scoped for v1; AC only verifies deny/allow.
findings.resolution: Resolved Open Question -> v1 allowlist-only; queue-consume UI is an explicit follow-up.

findings.description: 'no diff to their bodies' AC brittle to behavior-preserving refactors.
findings.resolution: Reworded to 'behavior and public contract unchanged'.

findings.description: Harness AC ambiguous on Fastify-route-with-auth vs injected-handler.
findings.resolution: US-006 drives the injected handler for the hermetic crypto round-trip + a separate route-level test for the Fastify/auth/hop boundary.
